My own timestamp arithmetic on review-passes.json independently reproduces the reported ~394-hour stall between the last stale behavior/docs-lane pass (2026-08-03T05:42/05:40) and the pass that followed round rotation (2026-08-19T16:35/16:33), matching the story's own account of why it sat this long.
